boundary: Additional unmeasured losses after delivered-fuel supplier are excluded by default; upstream emissions and HBEFA exhaust methane remain.
reason: Historical 0.004 cited a mixed LNG/CNG delivery, storage and vehicle loss boundary, not a residual beyond each bundled supplier.
qualification: Boundary correction, not empirical calibration of zero vehicle leakage. Use explicitly sourced residuals where available.
